title: BECE Physical Education - Physical & Health Education - Safety & First Aid
subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: The immediate and temporary care given to an injured person before professional medical help arrives is called ________.
questions.explain: First Aid is the initial assistance given to a victim of injury or illness.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: In the ABC of First Aid, what does 'A' stand for?
questions.explain: ABC stands for Airway, Breathing, and Circulation.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: A fracture where the bone breaks but does not pierce through the skin is called a ________ fracture.
questions.explain: In a simple or closed fracture, the broken bone remains inside the tissue and does not penetrate the skin.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which of the following is suitable for treating a fresh minor burn?
options: Pouring cool running water over it
questions.explain: Cool running water helps reduce the heat and pain. Grease keeps heat in, and ice can damage tissue.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of Artificial Respiration?
questions.explain: Artificial respiration (like mouth-to-mouth) is used to assist or stimulate respiration when breathing has stopped.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: A dislocation involves injury to a ________.
questions.explain: Dislocation occurs when bones at a joint are forced out of their normal positions.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Which item is commonly found in a First Aid box?
questions.explain: Iodine or Methylated Spirit are disinfectants commonly kept in First Aid kits.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: In case of a nosebleed, the victim should ________.
options: Sit up and pinch the soft part of the nose
questions.explain: Tilting the head back causes blood to run down the throat. Sitting up and pinching the nose stops the flow safely.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: A wound caused by a sharp object like a knife or razor is called an ________.
questions.explain: An incised wound constitutes a clean cut by a sharp edge.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: Muscle cramp is best treated immediately by ________.
questions.explain: Stretching relieves the involuntary contraction of the muscle.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.q: The condition where the body loses too much heat, often due to exposure to cold, is called ________.
questions.explain: Hypothermia is a dangerous drop in body temperature below 35°C.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education

questions.explain: CPR is an emergency lifesaving procedure performed when the heart stops beating.
questions.subject: Physical & Health Education
